name: recruiter-queries-v1
description: Source-backed draft judgments for the original 100 candidates/119 notes. Labels identify known positive examples, not exhaustive relevance judgments; human review pending. Evaluate retrieval/reranking tradeoffs, not hiring suitability.

search.query: Aircraft fueler seeking at least $27 per hour and open to overtime

cases.rationale: Resume identifies aircraft fueler; note states minimum pay and overtime willingness.

search.query: Customer service agent seeking $45K and only considering IAH or HOU roles

cases.rationale: Resume role plus separate location restriction and salary notes.

search.query: Gate agent looking for $25 per hour and needing three weeks notice

cases.rationale: Resume role combined with pay and notice notes.

search.query: Lead flight attendant willing to relocate to Orlando or Tampa

cases.rationale: Resume role plus explicit relocation preference in notes.

search.query: Avionics technician interested only in PHX based positions

cases.rationale: Resume specialization plus geographic restriction in notes.

search.query: Flight attendant who wants day shifts rather than overnight schedules

cases.rationale: Notes explicitly describe day preferences or restrictions; resume establishes role.

search.query: Flight dispatcher restricted to IAH or HOU based roles
Captain open to relocating with a preference for BOS or JFK

cases.rationale: Resume role plus Northeast relocation preference.

search.query: Aircraft fueler available to work overnight shifts

cases.rationale: Candidate 51 explicitly cannot work overnight. No exhaustive positive labels: measure demotion of this known contradiction, not empty-result correctness.
